title: 第一卷 第14章 你这人皇幡，怎么冒黑气？
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
时隔三日，姜家再次张灯结彩，处处挂满喜庆的红色。

    帝子大婚，相较于上次的隆重，此番一切从简。

    在经过一系列流程后，姜无痕轻车熟路的牵起沐云溪的小手，前往了早已装饰好的帝子殿。

    只是这次，婚房安排在了偏殿。

    灯火葳蕤，夜色撩人。

    姜无痕赶走了来闹洞房的众人，沐凝薇却无论如何都赖着不走。

    她跟沐云溪一起坐在婚床上，紧紧抱着她不放手。

    同时，这丫头看向姜无痕的眼神中，再次浮现出警惕。

    最后还是在沐云溪的规劝下，离开了婚房，被雪姨带走。

    “凝薇从小就跟着我睡，一时认生，让帝子见笑了……”

    红盖头下，沐云溪轻笑道。

    姜无痕坐在床边，用玉如意挑开了她的红盖头，看着她娇艳欲滴的绝美面容，紧紧地将她抱在怀里，迫不及待的亲了一口。

    待到二人分开时，呼吸都有些急促。

    “没关系，凝薇还小。如果她喜欢，可以过来跟你一起住……”姜无痕轻笑，双手开始不老实，“成亲之前，你喊帝子我不挑你理。现在，你该喊什么？”

    “夫君~”

    沐云溪嘤咛一声，连忙制止住了他的双手。

    “都洞房花烛了，你还想再矜持一下？”

    姜无痕坏笑道。

    沐云溪摇头，双手捧住了姜无痕的脸，一脸认真的道：“夫君，我知道……你除了我，还有其他女人。我并不会妨碍你三妻四妾，但我希望你答应我……放过凝薇，别打她的主意。”

    “她从小跟着我吃了很多苦，如今总算有了依靠。虽然她跟我并没有血缘关系，但我希望你答应我，永远让她喊你‘爹爹’，好吗？”

    沐云溪仰起小脸，眼神里满是祈求。

    跟女儿做姐妹这种事，她一时之间还接受不了。

    “我答应你，以后只让她喊我‘爸爸’！”

    姜无痕点头道。

    沐云溪这才露出笑意，主动亲了上去。

    姜无痕的动作越发粗暴，褪去了厚厚的婚服，只剩一袭轻薄的衣衫。

    鸳鸯喜被里，沐云溪双手抵住姜无痕的胸膛，眼神迷离道：“夫君，还记得在炎阳仙舟之上，你曾问过我，讨要那三滴帝血做什么吗？”

    “我现在不想知道了！”

    姜无痕抓住她的小手，企图冲破最后的阻碍。

    沐云溪却摇头，柔声细语的道：“你必须要知道，这三滴帝血，我想留一滴给凝薇，助她以后修炼。另外两滴，算是我的嫁妆……”

    言语间，她取出一滴。

    金色的帝血悬在二人之间，散发出阵阵帝威。

    “我的仙心玉体，在初次交合时，会在我们彼此体内留下印记。今后……我的身体，只属于你！”

    “仙心玉体又被称作双修神体，双修之际，无论是对道的感悟，还是修为提升，都有极大的增幅。而大帝的本源精血，拥有大帝的本源神力。若在初次双修时炼化，你我都将会得到难以想象的好处！”

    沐云溪解释着，双手不再抵着他的胸口，而是勾住了他的脖子。

    她望着那张近在咫尺的脸庞，眼神柔情似水：“夫君，我想……把最好的一切，都交给你……”

    姜无痕看着她一脸认真的模样，忍不住笑道：“夫人，你没必要想这么多，我要的从来都不是你的双修神体，而是你这个人。”

    “如果你真想为我做些什么的话，那就给我多生孩子，为家族添丁进口！”
content_en:
After three days, the Jiang family was once again decorated with lanterns and festive red colors everywhere.

    The emperor's son's wedding, compared to the grand ceremony last time, everything was kept simple this time.

    After going through a series of procedures, Jiang Wuhen took Mu Yunxi's little hand with ease and headed to the already decorated Emperor's Palace.

    Only this time, the wedding room was arranged in the side hall.

    The lights are bright and the night is sultry.

    Jiang Wuhen drove away everyone who came to make trouble at the wedding, but Mu Ningwei refused to leave no matter what.

    She sat on the wedding bed with Mu Yunxi, holding her tightly and not letting go.

    At the same time, the girl looked at Jiang Wuhen with vigilance in her eyes again.

    Finally, under Mu Yunxi's persuasion, she left the wedding room and was taken away by Aunt Xue.

    "Ningwei has been sleeping with me since she was a child. She gave in to others for a moment and made the emperor laugh..."

    Under the red hijab, Mu Yunxi chuckled.

    Jiang Wuhen sat by the bed, lifted her red hijab with Yu Ruyi, looked at her charming and beautiful face, held her tightly in his arms, and kissed her eagerly.

    When the two of them separated, their breathing was somewhat rapid.

    "It doesn't matter, Ningwei is still young. If she likes it, she can come and live with you..." Jiang Wuhen chuckled, and his hands began to be dishonest. "Before we got married, I didn't care if you called me son. Now, what should you call me?"

    "Husband~"

    Mu Yunxi snorted and quickly stopped his hands.

    "It's already a wedding, do you still want to be more reserved?"

    Jiang Wuhen said with a bad smile.

    Mu Yunxi shook her head, held Jiang Wuhen's face with both hands, and said with a serious face: "Husband, I know... you have other women besides me. I will not hinder your three wives and four concubines, but I hope you promise me... let Ningwei go and don't take advantage of her."

    "She has suffered a lot with me since she was a child, and now she finally has someone to rely on. Although she is not related to me by blood, I hope you promise me that she will always call you 'daddy', okay?"

    Mu Yunxi raised her little face, her eyes full of prayer.

    She couldn't accept being sisters with her daughter for a while.

    "I promise you, I will only let her call me 'Dad' from now on!"

    Jiang Wuhen nodded.

    Only then did Mu Yunxi smile and take the initiative to kiss her.

    Jiang Wuhen's movements became more and more rough, and he took off his thick wedding clothes, leaving only a light dress.

    Yuanyang was happy to be under the quilt. Mu Yunxi put her hands on Jiang Wuhen's chest and said with confused eyes: "Husband, do you still remember that on the Yanyang Immortal Boat, you once asked me what I wanted to do with those three drops of emperor's blood?"

    "I don't want to know now!"

    Jiang Wuhen grabbed her little hand and tried to break through the last obstacle.

    Mu Yunxi shook her head and whispered softly: "You must know that of these three drops of emperor's blood, I want to leave one drop for Ningwei to help her practice in the future. The other two drops can be regarded as my dowry..."

    As she spoke, she took out a drop.

    The golden emperor's blood hung between the two, exuding bursts of imperial power.

    "My immortal heart and jade body will leave a mark on each other's bodies when we have sex for the first time. From now on...my body belongs only to you!"

    "The Immortal Heart Jade Body is also called the dual cultivation divine body. During the dual cultivation, both the understanding of the Tao and the improvement of cultivation will be greatly increased. And the original essence and blood of the emperor possess the original divine power of the emperor. If you refine it during the first dual cultivation, you and I will get unimaginable benefits!"

    Mu Yunxi explained, her hands no longer pressed against his chest, but hooked around his neck.

    She looked at the face that was close at hand, her eyes were as tender as water: "Husband, I want... to give you the best of everything..."

    Jiang Wuhen looked at her serious look and couldn't help but smile: "Madam, you don't need to think so much. What I want has never been your dual cultivation body, but you as a person."

    "If you really want to do something for me, then give me more children to add to the family!"
